sources.title: Konstantin Mischaikow and Vidit Nanda, Morse Theory for Filtrations and Efficient Computation of Persistent Homology (2013) DCG 50 330–353

sources.title: Lebovici–Lerch–Oudot, Local characterization of block-decomposability for multiparameter persistence modules, original arXiv 2402.16624v4, HHA 28(1) (2026) 175–196
sources.origin: Original arXiv v4 author preprint 19pp; final HHA DOI 10.4310/HHA.2026.v28.n1.a9
sources.limitation: Original 2024v4 pdf opened; Theorem4/14, Definitions 3/7/9 and selected proofs pp 13–18 examined; journal final 2026 proof-equivalence NOT verified.
